") center center / cover no-repeat !important;}
.scene-cover .photo,.scene-close .photo {display:none !important}
.scene-cover::before,.scene-close::before{z-index:1!important;opacity:1!important;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(230,236,244,.91) 0%,rgba(237,239,243,.82) 34%,rgba(227,235,244,.67) 57%,rgba(231,236,243,.10) 74%,transparent 93%) !important}
.scene-cover .cover-copy,.scene-cover .cover-bullets,.scene-cover .cover-meta,.scene-close .close-head,.scene-close .close-steps,.scene-close .close-message{z-index:4!important}
.scene-cover .focus,.scene-close .close-step{background:rgba(245,248,252,.78)!important;border-color:rgba(245,249,255,.94)!important;box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(22,55,89,.14);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.scene-cover .cover-meta{background:rgba(241,245,249,.84)!important}
.scene-close .close-message{background:rgba(242,246,250,.79)!important;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 16px;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
/* V8 navigation controls are grouped at the bottom centre */
#menuBtn,#slidePrev,#slideNext{display:none!important}
.v8-controls{position:fixed;bottom:12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:5px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(146,180,208,.34);border-radius:15px;background:rgba(7,24,42,.91);box-shadow:0 9px 30px rgba(7,23,45,.22);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);z-index:52}
.v8-controls button{width:44px;height:40px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:22px;color:white;background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s ease,transform .18s ease}
.v8-controls button:hover{background:rgba(94,187,225,.24);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.v8-controls button:focus-visible,.col-sort:focus-visible,.col-filter:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #F37021;outline-offset:2px}
.v8-controls .v8-count{font:700 14px Consolas,monospace;color:#d9e7f2;padding:0 11px;letter-spacing:.08em;min-width:92px;text-align:center}
.v8-help{position:fixed;right:18px;top:16px;background:rgba(15,46,74,.77);color:#fff;z-index:50;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(218,238,255,.26);font-size:12px}
/* Compact detail popups - no duplicated KPI tiles */
.modal-body{padding-top:15px!important}.modal-toolbar{gap:9px!important;margin:4px 0 13px!important}
.modal-toolbar .pill{border-radius:11px!important}.modal-body .info-row{display:none!important}
.data-table{border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;table-layout:auto;width:100%}
.table-shell{max-height:550px;overflow:auto;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #d4e3ed}
.data-table thead th{position:sticky;top:0;background:#20598e;color:#fff;vertical-align:top;z-index:5;min-width:91px;padding:10px 9px 8px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11)}
.data-table thead th:nth-child(1){min-width:110px}
.data-table thead th:last-child{min-width:174px}
.data-table td{vertical-align:middle;padding:12px 11px;line-height:1.32}
.data-table tbody tr:nth-child(2n){background:rgba(232,243,251,.60)}
.data-table tbody tr:hover{background:#dbeeff!important}
.col-sort{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;gap:7px;color:white;background:transparent;border:0;font-weight:850;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;padding:0;min-height:28px;font-size:12px}
.col-sort::after{content:'↕';opacity:.70;font-size:13px}.col-sort.asc::after{content:'↑';opacity:1;color:#fff494}.col-sort.desc::after{content:'↓';opacity:1;color:#fff494}
.col-filter{width:100%;height:25px;border:1px solid rgba(223,235,249,.45);border-radius:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);color:white;padding:3px 7px;font-size:11px;margin-top:5px;outline:none}
.col-filter::placeholder{color:rgba(238,248,255,.78)}.col-filter:focus{background:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.data-table .center{text-align:center}.data-table .right{text-align:right}
.table-note{font-size:12px;color:#56728c;margin:7px 0 12px;line-height:1.45}
.sales-tabs{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.sales-tabs .pill{background:#edf6ff;color:#175b95;border:1px solid #cde3f5;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 15px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}.sales-tabs .pill.active{background:#145b95;color:#fff}
.v11-action{color:#995c14;font-weight:800;max-width:340px;line-height:1.32}.v11-substatus{margin-top:5px;color:#56748e;font-size:11px}
.v11-delta.negative{color:#cb4559;font-weight:800}.v11-delta.positive{color:#06895a;font-weight:800}.v11-delta.zero{color:#6a8192}
.scene-sales .same-period-badge{padding:8px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:#edf7ff;border:1px solid #d0e5f8;color:#205f94;font-weight:750;line-height:1.45;font-size:13px;margin-top:9px;max-width:100%}
.scene-sales .same-period-badge strong{color:#c94c60}
.scene-sales .team-panel .micro{font-size:12px}
@media (max-width:700px){.v8-help{display:none}.v8-controls{bottom:8px}.modal-body .table-shell{max-height:65vh}.data-table td{font-size:12px}}


/* V11 kickoff KTV × date matrix, FPT green and tier shading */
.kickoff-matrix .data-table thead th{background:#4D8930;color:#fff}
.kickoff-matrix tr.hd4 td{background:#FFF0A6}
.kickoff-matrix tr.hd3 td{background:#FDE5D9}
.kickoff-matrix tr.hd2 td{background:#E0F4DF}
.kickoff-matrix tr.hd1 td{background:#E4F0FF}
.kickoff-matrix .data-table tbody tr:hover td{background:#D6EBFF!important}
.kickoff-matrix .total-line{padding:12px 16px;background:#237641;color:#fff;font-weight:900;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;border-radius:0 0 12px 12px}
.kickoff-matrix .table-shell{border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;max-height:495px}
.kickoff-matrix .data-table td{text-align:center}.kickoff-matrix .data-table td:nth-child(2){text-align:left;font-weight:800}


/* ===== V12 refinements ===== */
.logo{gap:12px!important;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.2px}
.logo svg.fpt-svg{width:138px;height:34px;display:block;overflow:visible}
.logo .brand-join{margin:0 8px}
.logo .brand-unit{font-size:15px;font-weight:900;color:#0e3667;letter-spacing:.4px}
.topbar{top:34px!important}

/* slide 4 / kickoff re-balance */
.scene-kickoff .campaign-layout{grid-template-columns:620px 1fr!important;gap:22px!important;align-items:stretch}
.scene-kickoff .campaign-main{min-height:246px!important;padding:28px 30px 24px!important}
.scene-kickoff .campaign-main .giant{font-size:74px!important}
.scene-kickoff .campaign-main .sub{font-size:18px!important;line-height:1.45}
.scene-kickoff .campaign-summary-strip{padding:16px 18px;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#f3f9ff);border:1px solid #dce8f2;color:#44627f;font-size:15px;line-height:1.52}
.scene-kickoff .tiny-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:999px;background:#e9f4fe;color:#0f5b99;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;margin-right:8px}
.scene-kickoff .tiny-pill.orange{background:#fff0e3;color:#b35c17}
.scene-kickoff .poster-preview{padding:20px 22px 18px!important;min-height:396px!important}
.scene-kickoff .poster-headline{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.scene-kickoff .poster-headline .micro{margin-top:6px;max-width:520px}
.scene-kickoff .poster-shelf{height:292px!important;gap:14px!important;margin-top:16px!important}
.scene-kickoff .poster-shelf button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:8px 6px!important}
.scene-kickoff .poster-shelf img{border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(10,52,94,.12)}
.scene-kickoff .group-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:16px}
.scene-kickoff .group-tile{border:1px solid #dce8f2;border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;background:#f8fcff}
.scene-kickoff .group-tile b{display:block;color:var(--navy);font-size:15px;margin-bottom:5px}
.scene-kickoff .group-tile span{display:block;color:#62809a;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;min-height:37px}
.scene-kickoff .group-tile strong{display:block;margin-top:8px;color:var(--orange);font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.5px}
.scene-kickoff .campaign-choices{height:auto!important;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important}
.scene-kickoff .campaign-choices button{min-height:92px;padding:16px 18px!important;text-align:left}
.scene-kickoff .campaign-choices button span{display:block;line-height:1.35}

/* Modal/title/table polish */
.modal-top{padding:18px 24px 15px!important}
.modal-top small{font-size:11px!important;letter-spacing:1.15px!important}
.modal-top h2{font-size:19px!important;line-height:1.25!important;margin:4px 0 3px!important}
.modal-top p{font-size:12px!important;line-height:1.45!important;max-width:980px}
.modal-body{padding:16px 22px 22px!important}
.modal-toolbar{gap:8px!important;margin:2px 0 12px!important}
.modal-toolbar .pill{padding:9px 14px!important;font-size:12.5px!important}
.modal-toolbar input,.modal-toolbar select{padding:10px 12px!important;font-size:13px!important;min-width:130px!important}
.table-shell{border-radius:14px!important;border:1px solid #cfe1ee!important;max-height:560px!important}
.data-table{table-layout:fixed!important}
.data-table thead th{padding:8px 8px 7px!important;min-width:88px!important;font-size:12px!important}
.data-table thead th:nth-child(1){min-width:95px!important}
.data-table thead th:nth-child(2){min-width:112px!important}
.data-table thead th:last-child{min-width:245px!important}
.col-sort{font-size:11.5px!important;min-height:23px!important}
.col-filter{height:24px!important;font-size:12px!important;border-radius:7px!important;padding:4px 7px!important}
.data-table td{padding:10px 10px!important;font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.34!important}
.data-table td:nth-child(2){font-size:14px!important}
.data-table .num{font-size:15px!important;font-weight:850!important;color:#19476f}
.data-table .right{font-size:14px!important;font-weight:850!important}
.data-table .strong{font-weight:900!important}
.data-table .danger{color:#c63755!important}
.data-table .ok{color:#0f8652!important}
.statusbadge{margin-top:5px!important}
.line-action{font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.42!important;color:#9f6315!important}
.note,.table-note{font-size:12.5px!important;line-height:1.5!important;color:#5f7892!important}
.kickoff-matrix .total-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:10px 14px;color:#486783;font-size:13px;background:#f7fbff;border:1px solid #d5e5f0;border-top:0;border-radius:0 0 12px 12px}


/* =============== V13 / SLIDE 3 & CONTROLS =============== */
/* V8 navigation language with a lighter translucent glass surface */
.v8-controls{background:rgba(11,39,68,.52)!important;border:1px solid rgba(201,227,247,.54)!important;box-shadow:0 9px 28px rgba(6,41,81,.16)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(17px) saturate(145%)!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(17px) saturate(145%)!important;padding:4px 9px!important;border-radius:16px!important}
.v8-controls button{color:#f7fbff!important;text-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(6,28,51,.28);transition:background .2s,transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.v8-controls button:hover{background:rgba(239,248,255,.28)!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.26);transform:translateY(-1px)!important}
.v8-controls .v8-count{color:#ffffff!important;text-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(5,25,48,.45)!important}
.v8-help{background:rgba(13,48,79,.47)!important;border-color:rgba(212,239,255,.37)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(12px) saturate(140%)!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px) saturate(140%)!important;box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(6,37,77,.07)!important}

/* Slide 3: dedicated grid; content never overlaps */
.scene-staff .staff-head{top:119px;left:76px;right:76px}
.scene-staff .staff-head h1{font-size:43px!important;line-height:1.08!important;margin:8px 0 0!important;letter-spacing:-1.35px}
.scene-staff .staff-desc{font-size:15px;color:#65809b;line-height:1.4;margin:9px 0 0;font-weight:600}
.scene-staff .staff-kpis{position:absolute;top:230px;left:76px;right:76px;margin-top:0!important;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;height:126px}
.scene-staff .staff-kpis .kpi{padding:16px 18px!important;min-width:0;min-height:0;height:126px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;border-radius:17px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(35,92,152,.075)}
.scene-staff .staff-kpis .klabel{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.35px;line-height:1.25}
.scene-staff .staff-kpis .knumber{font-size:36px;margin:4px 0 3px;line-height:1}
.scene-staff .staff-kpis .knote{font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.35}.scene-staff .staff-kpis .knumber.purple{color:#7C4DD7}.scene-staff .staff-motto{position:absolute;top:186px;left:76px;right:76px;text-align:center;font-size:18px;font-weight:900;color:#E7601C}.scene-staff .staff-motto span{color:var(--navy);font-style:italic}
.scene-staff .staff-layout{top:380px;bottom:76px;left:76px;right:76px;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.52fr) minmax(0,.82fr);gap:20px;align-items:stretch}
.scene-staff .staff-team,.scene-staff .staff-aside{min-width:0;min-height:0;height:100%;border-radius:19px;overflow:hidden}
.scene-staff .staff-team{padding:21px 23px 13px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(48,95,140,.08)}
.scene-staff .staff-team-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:15px}
.scene-staff .staff-section-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:900;color:#5682a6;letter-spacing:1.25px}
.scene-staff .staff-team .headline{font-size:25px;letter-spacing:-.55px;margin-top:4px}
.scene-staff .staff-detail-link{padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid #c9e1f2;border-radius:10px;color:#155ea6;background:#f1f8ff;font-size:12px;font-weight:850;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.scene-staff .staff-detail-link span{color:#f37021;font-size:17px;margin-left:4px}
.scene-staff .staff-detail-link:hover{background:#e6f4ff;border-color:#7bbde9;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.scene-staff .team-report{width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;flex:1}
.scene-staff .team-report-head,.scene-staff .team-report-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(133px,1.45fr) minmax(76px,.68fr) minmax(77px,.70fr) minmax(145px,1.55fr) 30px;align-items:center;gap:13px}
.scene-staff .team-report-head{color:#68839e;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.6px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddeaf3;padding:2px 9px 10px}
.scene-staff .team-report-head span:nth-child(2),.scene-staff .team-report-head span:nth-child(3){text-align:center}
.scene-staff .team-report-row{--team-accent:#1877c1;width:100%;height:56px;max-height:56px;flex:1;flex-shrink:0;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #e7eff6;text-align:left;padding:0 9px;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s ease,transform .2s ease;color:#18395e}
.scene-staff .team-report-row:hover{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#edf8ff,rgba(249,253,255,.3));transform:translateX(3px)}
.scene-staff .team-report-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:-3px}
.scene-staff .teamrow-loc{--team-accent:#ef9b40}
.scene-staff .teamrow-thinh{--team-accent:#27b77e}
.scene-staff .teamrow-khanh{--team-accent:#ad80d8}
.scene-staff .teamrow-sang{--team-accent:#eb84a0}
.scene-staff .team-report-row .team-num{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:4px;font-size:20px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-.4px;justify-content:center;color:#154779}
.scene-staff .team-report-row .team-num small{font-size:9px;font-weight:800;color:#7b94a9}
.scene-staff .team-report-row .team-plan{text-align:center;color:#758ca2;font-weight:800;font-size:15px}
.scene-staff .team-report-row .team-result b{color:var(--team-accent);font-size:17px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.1px;display:block;margin-bottom:7px;line-height:1}
.scene-staff .team-progress-track{height:7px;width:100%;border-radius:99px;background:#e7f0f8;overflow:hidden;display:block}
.scene-staff .team-progress-track i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:99px;max-width:100%;transition:width 1s ease}
.scene-staff .team-arrow{color:var(--team-accent);font-size:20px;opacity:.65;text-align:center;border-radius:8px}
.scene-staff .team-report-row:hover .team-arrow{opacity:1;transform:translate(2px,-2px)}
.scene-staff .staff-table-foot{font-size:11px;color:#7890a5;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:auto;padding:11px 3px 1px}
.scene-staff .staff-table-foot span:last-child{color:#0e619f;font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap}
.scene-staff .staff-aside{padding:24px 25px 20px!important;background:linear-gradient(147deg,rgba(29,108,186,.96),rgba(15,62,131,.96))!important;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-start;border-color:rgba(16,77,136,.7)}
.scene-staff .staff-aside .staff-section-label{color:#c2eaff}
.scene-staff .staff-aside h2{font-size:24px;line-height:1.16;margin:11px 0 15px;letter-spacing:-.35px;color:#fff}
.scene-staff .staff-aside h2 em{font-style:normal;color:#a9edfd}
.scene-staff .staff-action-steps{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;flex:1;min-height:0}
.scene-staff .staff-action-step{border-top:1px solid rgba(236,249,255,.25);padding:12px 0 9px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:34px 1fr;gap:8px;color:#fff}
.scene-staff .step-index{font-size:16px;font-weight:950;color:#9ceaff}
.scene-staff .staff-action-step b{font-size:14px;line-height:1.25;display:block}
.scene-staff .staff-action-step p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.43;margin:5px 0 0;color:#e1f2ff}
.scene-staff .staff-aside-cta{border:0;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;padding:12px 15px;color:#0e5ba0;font-size:13px;font-weight:950;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:12px;transition:background .2s ease,transform .2s ease}
.scene-staff .staff-aside-cta:hover{background:#e9f7ff;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.scene-staff .staff-aside-cta span{color:#f37021;font-size:20px}

/* Uniformly readable and compact detail tables with filters kept in header */
#monthSalesContent .table-shell,#staffRows .table-shell{border:1px solid #d5e6f1!important;border-radius:13px!important;max-height:57vh!important;box-shadow:0 5px 21px rgba(22,62,106,.06)}
#monthSalesContent .data-table,#staffRows .data-table{table-layout:fixed;width:100%;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0}
#monthSalesContent .data-table thead th,#staffRows .data-table thead th{background:#256296!important;color:white!important;padding:10px 11px 9px!important;border-right:1px solid rgba(218,237,251,.18)!important}
#monthSalesContent .data-table td,#staffRows .data-table td{border-right:1px solid #e9f0f6;border-bottom:1px solid #e9f0f6;padding:11px 11px!important;line-height:1.33}
#monthSalesContent .data-table th:nth-child(1){width:106px}
#monthSalesContent .data-table th:nth-child(2){width:120px}
#monthSalesContent .data-table th:nth-child(3),#monthSalesContent .data-table th:nth-child(4),#monthSalesContent .data-table th:nth-child(5){width:126px}

#monthSalesContent .data-table td:nth-child(2),#staffRows .data-table td:nth-child(2){color:#11365d;font-weight:900}
#monthSalesContent .data-table td.num,#staffRows .data-table td.num{font-size:15px!important;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:850}
#monthSalesContent .col-sort,#staffRows .col-sort{line-height:1.3;min-height:26px;color:#fff}
#monthSalesContent .col-filter,#staffRows .col-filter{height:27px!important;margin-top:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.20);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.46);color:white;font-size:11.5px}
#monthSalesContent .col-filter::placeholder,#staffRows .col-filter::placeholder{color:#e6f5ff}
#monthSalesContent .col-filter:focus,#staffRows .col-filter:focus{background:#fff;color:#124773;border-color:#fcb576}
#monthSalesContent .col-filter:focus::placeholder,#staffRows .col-filter:focus::placeholder{color:#7e9ab1}
#monthSalesContent .v11-action{color:#8c5f25;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.37}
#monthSalesContent .statusbadge{margin-top:5px}


/* Slide 8: V13 closing visual, image-only background sourced from existing AI assets */
.scene-thanks{background:#0e2845;color:#fff}
.scene-thanks:before{display:none}
.scene-thanks .photo.thanks-bg{position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;max-width:none!important;object-fit:cover!important;object-position:center 42%!important;mask-image:none!important;-webkit-mask-image:none!important;opacity:1!important;filter:saturate(1.08) contrast(1.03)!important}
.scene-thanks .thanks-veil{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(4,24,47,.91) 0%,rgba(7,36,62,.79) 27%,rgba(9,37,62,.60) 48%,rgba(6,28,49,.12) 75%,rgba(2,15,29,.12) 100%)}
.scene-thanks .hero-glow{z-index:1;opacity:.25}
.scene-thanks .topbar{z-index:10}
.scene-thanks .logo{border-radius:12px;padding:6px 13px;background:rgba(250,253,255,.94);box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
.scene-thanks .topbar .eyebrow{color:#D4F3FF}
.scene-thanks .topbar .tag{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.24);color:#fff}
.scene-thanks .thanks-content{position:absolute;left:85px;top:216px;width:770px;z-index:4}
.scene-thanks .thanks-eyebrow{font-size:17px;letter-spacing:2.1px;color:#8ceaff;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:28px}
.scene-thanks .thanks-title{font-size:91px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-3.6px;line-height:1.07;color:#fff;margin:0;text-shadow:0 9px 32px rgba(5,15,40,.22)}
.scene-thanks .thanks-title span{color:#ff8b37}
.scene-thanks .thanks-subtitle{color:#d6f4ff;font-size:34px;letter-spacing:.5px;margin:17px 0 20px;font-weight:900}
.scene-thanks .thanks-desc{color:#f0f8ff;font-size:19px;line-height:1.62;max-width:705px;margin:0 0 27px;font-weight:550;text-wrap:pretty}
.scene-thanks .thanks-topics{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.scene-thanks .thanks-topics span{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);border:1px solid rgba(220,244,255,.32);border-radius:999px;color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;padding:11px 14px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.scene-thanks .thanks-last{position:absolute;bottom:107px;left:85px;color:#b0e9ff;font-size:14px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.7px;z-index:4}
.scene-thanks .footer{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.31);color:#c3e5ff;z-index:10}
.scene-thanks .footer b{color:#eff8ff}
.scene-thanks .footer .mini-tag{color:#eaf7ff}


.award-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:0 0 14px}.award-summary .info-chip{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f9fcff,#eef6ff);border-color:#d4e4f0;min-width:0}.award-summary .info-chip b{font-size:26px}
.award-board .table-shell{border:1px solid #c8dceb;border-radius:16px 16px 0 0;max-height:500px;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(28,76,126,.08)}
.award-board .data-table thead th{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5a9633,#4b842d);color:#fff;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
.award-board .data-table td{padding:13px 12px;font-size:14px;color:#1f4262}
.award-board .data-table td:nth-child(1),.award-board .data-table td:nth-child(n+3){text-align:center}.award-board .data-table td:nth-child(2){text-align:left;font-weight:800}
.award-board .award-name{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}.award-board .award-name b{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--navy)}.award-board .award-sub{font-size:11px;color:#6d8295;font-weight:700}
.award-board tr.hd4 td{background:#FFF0A8}.award-board tr.hd3 td{background:#FCE4D6}.award-board tr.hd2 td{background:#E1F2E0}.award-board tr.hd1 td{background:#E5EFFB}
.award-board .data-table tbody tr:hover td{background:#D8EDFF!important}.award-board .total-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 16px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#257845,#176239);color:#fff;font-weight:900;border-radius:0 0 16px 16px}.award-board .table-note{margin-bottom:10px}
@media(max-width:1200px){.award-summary{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}

.sales-detail-board .table-shell{border:1px solid #d2e1ed;border-radius:16px;max-height:58vh;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(23,77,126,.08)}
.sales-detail-board .data-table{min-width:980px}
.sales-detail-board .data-table th{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2D6CA6,#255E91);padding:11px 12px 9px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.sales-detail-board .data-table td{padding:12px 12px;vertical-align:middle;font-size:14px}
.sales-detail-board .data-table tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:#F7FBFF}.sales-detail-board .data-table tbody tr:hover{background:#EAF5FF}
.sales-detail-board .data-table td:nth-child(2){color:#173d66;font-size:14.5px}.sales-detail-board .data-table td .mini-note{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#748aa0;font-weight:700;margin-top:3px}
.sales-detail-board .data-table .num.strong{font-size:24px;line-height:1}.sales-detail-board .data-table td.goal{color:#5d7387;font-weight:800;background:#f4f8fc}
.sales-detail-board .data-table td.delta-cell{font-weight:900;font-size:20px}.sales-detail-board .data-table td.rate-cell{font-weight:900;font-size:26px}.sales-detail-board .data-table td.rate-cell span{font-size:13px}
.result-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid transparent}
.result-chip.done{background:#DCF3E4;color:#146D3D;border-color:#BFE6CC}.result-chip.over{background:#D8EFFB;color:#0C5D9A;border-color:#B8DAF3}.result-chip.near{background:#FFF2CC;color:#97640F;border-color:#F1DE9E}.result-chip.weak{background:#FFE7D4;color:#AF6111;border-color:#F6D1A7}.result-chip.start{background:#FFE3E8;color:#B23551;border-color:#F6C5D0}.result-chip.entry{background:#E6F1FF;color:#205F9E;border-color:#C7DBF8}.result-chip.speed{background:#FFF1D8;color:#9B6A10;border-color:#F1DBA7}
.result-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;align-items:flex-start}.action-copy{color:#8E5A11;font-weight:800;line-height:1.35;max-width:360px}.sales-note{font-size:12.5px;color:#698198;margin:10px 0 12px;line-height:1.45}.sales-detail-board .team-mark{min-width:76px;justify-content:center}
